about.title: Beyond the Role
heading: Starting in electronics,
through software, back to devices and applications.
about.p1: I graduated from Xidian University in Electronic Science and Technology, began my career in automotive electronics at BYD, then spent years in mobile software development. Since 2024 I have been an FAE at Zhuzhou Hongda, providing technical support for discrete devices and integrated circuits.
about.p2: I bring the analytical, collaborative and continuous-improvement practices from software engineering into semiconductor technical support.
